coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded hourly window met the qualifying criteria.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
exclusions_observed: Returned grocery-store candidates were older than the bounded hourly window or did not establish loss of the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store in a community.
Returned storm/flood and food-distribution items described distributions proceeding, preparedness, or older events rather than a new cancellation or suspension in the bounded window.
Returned SNAP/WIC items were older policy or funding coverage and did not establish a new immediate benefit-access interruption in the bounded window.
Other results were older, non-U.S., routine, promotional, generic, or otherwise outside scope.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
